date_scope_check.qualification: SA031-D1: Source priority is given to the August 12 OnlineKhabar report describing an existing closure since the previous weekend, bounded as August 6–7. The Kathmandu Post September 15 retrospective date of August 14 is retained as a conflicting account, but cannot describe the first onset of a closure already reported on August 12. Nepal News also describes an early-August shutdown. This does not prove an exact hour or exclude an unreported intervening change. The September 15 endpoint is initial inbound festival cargo restoration, not unrestricted two-way trade or passenger normalisation. Nepal-to-China exports remain a separate directional phase in SA029.
